description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer reflow/virtual-bottom checkpoint: safe Rust composes the existing TextBuffer reflow owner with virtual-bottom viewport/cursor state for the two remaining reflow-dependent virtual-bottom contracts.

entries.notes: Safe Rust composes TextBuffer reflow with VirtualBottomState: shrink reflow keeps virtual bottom at or below the final non-space row, and a subsequent grow reflow preserves cursor distance from the virtual bottom.
Safe Rust verifies that shrinking width with reflow while viewport and cursor are at buffer top cannot reduce virtual bottom below the viewport bottom.
